items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for Sunday’s game vs. Rams due to his hamstring injury.
items.implication: Sit Smith; look to other PHI receivers/TE for volume.
items.opportunity: Target/route share redistribution in PHI offense vs LAR

items.text: Aaron Donald is out for Sunday’s game vs. the Eagles due to his back injury. Puka Nacua is expected to play.
items.why: Coach/practice progression from groin/hip; Schefter confirmation.
items.implication: Start Nacua with confidence as WR1 returns.

items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson is out Sunday due to his sprained ankle.
items.why: Sprained ankle; ruled out on final injury report.
items.implication: Sit Jefferson; boost to MIN pass catchers in favorable matchup.

items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall and WR Adonai Mitchell for Sunday’s game vs. the Bears.
items.opportunity: Lead back carries/snaps/goal-line for Jets RB2

items.text: Kyle Shanahan said WR Mike Evans, who is dealing with a rib injury, will be a game-time decision.
items.opportunity: If out, boost to other SF WRs/TE

items.text: Tough runout for Jadarian Price through first month in NFL: Lost goal-line (and some base) work to Emmanuel Wilson; Lost pass-down work to George Holani; Lost fumbles in back-to-back games; Is hurt (chest); Zach Charbonnet (ACL) back at practice. That said, Price passes eye test and has run well when given chances. Far, far, far from over for Price longer-term. Projections updated for Price (chest).
items.why: Role erosion + chest injury + Charbonnet returning to practice.
items.implication: Temper near-term expectations; long-term still viable.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is off the injury report and good to go Sunday vs. the Titans.
items.why: Off injury report after back maintenance.
items.implication: Full start; unlocks BAL skill players.
items.opportunity: Normal dual-threat usage, red-zone/ dual-threat snaps

items.text: Nico Collins is good to go.
items.why: Friday injury report confirmation vs DAL.

items.text: Only a 4-game sample. But with Dylan Sampson (knee) out virtually all season, Quinshon Judkins has seen a solid 13.8% target share. With Sampson healthy for most of 2025, Judkins was at 8.3%. Judkins now on pace to catch 64 passes.
items.why: Elevated target share with teammate out; pace for 64 catches.
items.implication: Higher PPR floor/ceiling as pass-catching RB.

items.text: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels officially is out Sunday.
items.opportunity: Backup QB volume; WAS skill player script change

items.text: Jaylen Warren on LOVE list as top-10 play: led all RBs with 90% snap rate last week, 20 of 22 RB touches with Dowdle out. Cleveland allows big RB yards.
Jeremiyah Love on LOVE list: RB5 utilization, 26 touches (more than W1+W2 combined), double-digit target share every game; Giants allow 5.1 YPC.
items.why: Massive recent usage spike and efficiency opportunity.
items.opportunity: High touches, target share, rush attempts

items.text: Omarion Hampton on HATE list: low utilization (RB27), 3.5% targets, 25% routes, snap rate dropped to 42%, only 13% third downs; SEA allows 2.9 YPC.
Drake London on LOVE: 35% career target share/104 ypg with Penix; 43.5% share last week (9-194); NO allows many WR TDs.
items.why: Elite connection with Penix returning; volume spike.
items.opportunity: High target share, red-zone with Penix
